text:
incident-bot: [INCIDENT] Elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate from us-east. Several model-runner processes crashed (OOM/SIGSEGV). Paging oncall.

oncall-mary: on it, joining the bridge. any confirmed customer impact yet?

eng-sre-jake: quick dump from logs -> repeated OOM then segfault in quantized attention kernel. attaching trace snippet below.

eng-sre-jake: ```
[2026-03-17T14:01:23Z] model-runner[pid=4321]: segfault at 0x0 ip 0x7f8a2c1f12f qattn.so +0x12f
#0 0x7f8a2c1f12f qattn::forward(void*)
#1 0x7f8a2d2b3aa runtime::execute(request)
#2 0x7f8a2d2b5cc start_worker
```

runtime-ryan: seeing KV cache growth to ~48GB on affected nodes + long seq requests from a few heavy clients. pattern: long prefix + repeating streaming clients -> mem blowout -> OOM -> segfault.

oncall-mary: can we mitigate without full rollback? we need fast customer relief.

eng-sre-jake: proposed short-term mitigations:
- route 30% traffic to model-variant-lite (no quantized kernel)
- enable degraded-mode (disable persistent KV cache)
- scale up model-runner pool by +2 nodes and drain unhealthy pods
- collect coredumps for postmortem

runtime-ryan: running actions now. commands:
```
# shift traffic (gateway)
rgctl route set /v1/generate --variant model-variant-lite --percent 30 --region us-east
# scale pool
rcctl pool scale model-runner-pool --add 2 --region us-east
# restart pod to flush KV cache on node-3
kubectl delete pod model-runner-03 -n inference --grace-period=30
```

ops-bot: Automated: routing change accepted, 30% -> model-variant-lite (us-east). Autoscale request queued.

cs-anna: customer update: Support has 3 tickets opened (enterprise customers) reporting 5xx and timeouts since 13:58 UTC. We flagged for SLA breach; customers notified that we're mitigating.

oncall-mary: thanks @cs-anna. please push a brief status to the incident channel and to affected customers: "we're seeing elevated errors; engineers are mitigating; temporary routing applied".

eng-sre-jake: toggled degraded-mode:```
/infra/config set inference.kv_cache.enabled false --env prod --model default
```

runtime-ryan: confirmed coredump grabbed and uploaded: s3://redwood-incidents/4321123456/core-model-runner-03.dmp (sha256: e3b0c442...). will trigger symbolization and attach to the ticket.

ops-bot: Health check: error rate dropped from 9% -> 0.8% over last 5m after routing+degraded-mode. Latency improved.

oncall-mary: keeping channel open for 30m monitoring, then hand to postmortem. next steps: collect full traces, diff kernel selection heuristics, identify offending client payloads.

eng-sre-jake: preliminary root-cause hypothesis: quantized attention kernel (qattn.so) misbehaves under large KV state growth; fallback path not engaged because kernel selection favored quantized variant for perf. will prepare hotpatch to force non-qattn path for long-seq requests.

cs-anna: customers acknowledged the update and saw fewer errors. one customer requested ETA for a full fix.

oncall-mary: ETA: hotpatch + validated rollout by EOD (tentative). I'll open an incident ticket and assign to eng-ml + eng-sre.

eng-sre-jake: noted. I'll post stack trace + coredump link in the ticket.

ops-bot: Incident: mitigation succeeded -> monitoring holds. Marking as "mitigated" but not "resolved". Creating follow-up: PM-4321 (postmortem + customer comms). :white_check_mark:

oncall-mary: good work team. stay on watch for 30 more minutes, then move to postmortem channel. :thumbsup:
